dodge.text: Press {key:dodge} to roll out of the way.
dodge.touch: Tap the arrow to roll out of the way.

fright.text: Monsters far below your level run from you.

skill.touch: {skill}: tap its button to use it.

journal.touch: Open your journal from the Menu.

forget.text: Old Hessa at the shrine gives your points back, free the first time.

skill_full.text: All six keys are taken: put {skill} on one in Skills ({key:skills}).
skill_full.touch: All six buttons are taken: put {skill} on one in Skills (Menu).

board.text: Face the notice board and press {key:interact} to fund the village's projects.
board.touch: Face the notice board and tap the hand to fund the village's projects.

bounty.text: Kill a named monster and its bounty is yours.

post.text: Face the post box and press {key:interact} for the post.
post.touch: Face the post box and tap the hand for the post.

turn.text: Turn your phone sideways for more room.

potion.text: Hurt? Open your pack ({key:inventory}) and drink a potion ({key:interact}).
potion.touch: Hurt? Open your pack from the Menu and drink a potion.

house.text: Home: the barrel keeps your things, the bed gives more XP.

deed.text: A business you own pays rent daily, and you pay a tenth less there.

bank.text: Banked gold earns a little daily and is safe when you fall.
